brief: Prioritise Kelvedon Vale for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure under thermal cycling [MG-023]. Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. If the event is forecast to run beyond 48 hours with warm overnight minima, apply the loading reduction in MG-021 from the third day and run forced cooling continuously through the overnight period rather than allowing the thermostat to drop the stages out [MG-025].
